title: Sponsor briefing document (synthetic)
text: MRD-12 is an oral small molecule. The recommended phase 2 dose is 40 mg once daily. The proposed primary endpoint is the change in functional score at 24 weeks. Safety and tolerability will be assessed over 24 weeks, with treatment-emergent and serious adverse events followed to week 28. Trough sampling at weeks 4, 12 and 24 will support exposure-response analysis. Participants must be eligible for the platform as defined in Master Protocol section 5.1. An estimated glomerular filtration rate of at least 45 mL/min/1.73 m2 is required. Placebo tablets matching MRD-12 will be used for blinding against the shared control.

title: Investigator brochure extract (synthetic)
text: MRD-12 is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate. A dose-dependent QTc prolongation was observed above 80 mg. No hepatic signal in phase 1.
